description: List the managed MySQL/MariaDB databases of a gameserver with host, port, database name, username, status and phpMyAdmin URL. Passwords are never returned: the owner sees them in the dashboard. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_gameserver_databases
title: List Game Server Databases
